summary: Built and verified the three-node Redis/Sentinel service. Final state is node1 primary with synchronized replicas node2/node3, three healthy Sentinels monitoring infra-primary, infra:proof=ready, authenticated mutual TLS on both service ports, and restart persistence on every node.
actions_performed: Installed Redis 7 and configured AOF persistence and replication.
Generated node-local private keys, CA-signed certificates, ACL credentials, and root-only administrative credentials.
Configured Redis TLS on 6379 and Sentinel TLS on 26379 with plaintext ports disabled.
Demonstrated automatic promotion during a node1 Redis outage and synchronized recovery of the former primary.
Safely rebooted node1, node2, and node3 sequentially, restoring full health before each subsequent reboot.

evidence.requirement: Initial node1 primary with node2 and node3 replicas
evidence.summary: node1 reported two online replicas; both replicas reported an up-to-date link to node1.

evidence.requirement: Three Sentinels monitor infra-primary with quorum
evidence.summary: Each Sentinel reported infra-primary, two replicas, two peer Sentinels, and quorum 2.
SET succeeded, WAIT returned two acknowledgements, and both replicas returned ready.

evidence.requirement: Authenticated TLS for Redis and Sentinel across all nodes
evidence.summary: All certificates validate, authenticated TLS returns PONG on both ports, plaintext/client-certificate-less/ACL-less access is rejected, and persisted configs disable plaintext ports.
/root/redis-admin.env exists as root:root mode 600 and its credentials successfully authenticate after reboot.

evidence.requirement: Automatic promotion and synchronized recovery of former primary
evidence.summary: Only node1 Redis was stopped; Sentinel promoted node3, node3 remained writable with replica acknowledgement, and node1 returned as a synchronized replica containing both data markers.
node1 is the final primary with two online replicas; node2/node3 are synchronized, all Sentinels agree, and infra:proof remains ready.
Captured healthy baseline, reboot acknowledgement, changed boot ID, and recovered Redis/Sentinel/data/quorum.
Captured healthy baseline, reboot acknowledgement, changed boot ID, and recovered Redis/Sentinel/data/quorum.
Captured healthy primary baseline, reboot acknowledgement, changed boot ID, automatic replacement, and node3 recovery as a synchronized replica with full quorum.
